articles.title: Why climate forcing is not equal everywhere: New model tests show polar changes can be more than three times as powerful as global ones
articles.description: Recent studies reveal that the geographical location of warming is just as crucial as its intensity. Polar regions cause a significantly greater response in global temperatures compared to tropical areas, which have a milder impact. This difference emphasizes the importance of regional feedback mechanisms in amplifying climate change effects. For improved climate predictions, future models must take into account the location of warming influences.

articles.title: Manish Gunwani Bets On Banks, Sees Domestic Sectors Leading As AI Trade Faces Fatigue
articles.description: Bandhan AMC CIO – Equity, Manish Gunwani, shares his outlook on markets, sectors and investment strategy amid rising geopolitical uncertainty and shifting global trends. He says India has weathered several challenges over the past two years, including geopolitical tensions, tariff concerns and a slowing economy, but believes domestic sectors are now better positioned to outperform. Gunwani is bullish on private banks, NBFCs, insurance, real estate and consumer discretionary, citing improving domestic demand, healthy credit growth and resilient retail asset quality. While he expects large private banks to deliver steady returns, he believes alpha will come from careful stock selection in smaller financial companies and fintechs. On the global front, he believes the AI-driven rally may be showing signs of fatigue after sharp gains in semiconductor and AI-related stocks. He remains cautious on IT services, saying the long-term impact of AI is still difficult to assess and investors should avoid taking aggressive positions until there is greater clarity. Gunwani is also positive on asset management companies, highlighting their strong cash generation and long-term growth potential. Looking ahead, he expects Indian corporate earnings to improve but warns investors to closely monitor global bond yields and the trajectory of AI spending, which could shape market direction over the coming years.
